instruction: Set the default image resolution to 150 ppi in GIMP preferences.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate to GIMP preferences and set the default image resolution to 150 ppi. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for 'default-image default-resolution 150.000000'. Uses existing check_config_status metric and get_gimp_config_file getter with two-part key.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if default-image default-resolution is set to 150.000000, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Critical parsing logic error in check_config_status metric at gimp.py:517-538
The metric attempts to parse nested GIMP config format '(default-image (default-resolution 150.000000))' but the parsing logic is incorrect
After stripping parentheses and splitting, items[1] will be '(default-resolution' (with leading parenthesis), not 'default-resolution'
The two-part key check at line 535-537 will fail because items[1] == rule['key'][1] will be '(default-resolution' == 'default-resolution' which is false
The evaluator will always return 0.0 even when the correct setting exists in the config file
Postconfig is appropriate (closes GIMP to save settings), and getter correctly retrieves the config file, but metric logic is broken
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix the parsing logic in check_config_status to properly handle nested parentheses in GIMP config format
Option 1: Strip all parentheses from each item after splitting: items = [item.strip('()') for item in items]
Option 2: Use regex to properly parse GIMP config S-expression format
Option 3: For two-part keys, check if items[1].startswith('(') and strip it before comparison
Add test cases to verify parsing works for GIMP's nested config format: '(default-image (default-resolution 150.000000))'
